#include <game.h>

#define CELL_SIZE 10
#define BOARD_TOP 20
/// 盤面の横方向のマス数です。
#define BOARD_COLUMNS (GAME_SCREEN_WIDTH / CELL_SIZE)
/// 盤面の縦方向のマス数です。
#define BOARD_ROWS ((GAME_SCREEN_HEIGHT - BOARD_TOP) / CELL_SIZE)
/// 盤面に収まるヘビの最大の長さです。
#define MAX_SNAKE_LENGTH (BOARD_COLUMNS * BOARD_ROWS)
#define START_LENGTH 4
#define MOVE_INTERVAL 6

enum Direction {
  DIRECTION_LEFT,
  DIRECTION_RIGHT,
  DIRECTION_UP,
  DIRECTION_DOWN
};

static int snake_x[MAX_SNAKE_LENGTH];
static int snake_y[MAX_SNAKE_LENGTH];
static int snake_length;
static int food_x;
static int food_y;
static int direction;
static int queued_direction;
static int direction_queued;
static int move_timer;
static int game_over;
static int game_won;
static char score_text[12];

static int snake_occupies(int x, int y, int count) {
  int i;
  for (i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    if (snake_x[i] == x && snake_y[i] == y) {
      return 1;
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

static void update_score_text(void) {
  int value = snake_length - START_LENGTH;
  int hundreds = value / 100;
  int tens = (value / 10) % 10;
  int ones = value % 10;
  int position = 7;

  score_text[0] = 'S';
  score_text[1] = 'c';
  score_text[2] = 'o';
  score_text[3] = 'r';
  score_text[4] = 'e';
  score_text[5] = ':';
  score_text[6] = ' ';
  if (hundreds > 0) {
    score_text[position++] = (char)('0' + hundreds);
  }
  if (hundreds > 0 || tens > 0) {
    score_text[position++] = (char)('0' + tens);
  }
  score_text[position++] = (char)('0' + ones);
  score_text[position] = '\0';
}

static void place_food(void) {
  int start = (int)(random_next() % (unsigned int)MAX_SNAKE_LENGTH);
  int attempt;
  for (attempt = 0; attempt < MAX_SNAKE_LENGTH; attempt++) {
    int cell = (start + attempt) % MAX_SNAKE_LENGTH;
    int x = cell % BOARD_COLUMNS;
    int y = cell / BOARD_COLUMNS;
    if (!snake_occupies(x, y, snake_length)) {
      food_x = x;
      food_y = y;
      return;
    }
  }
  game_over = 1;
  game_won = 1;
}

static void reset_game(void) {
  int i;
  snake_length = START_LENGTH;
  for (i = 0; i < snake_length; i++) {
    snake_x[i] = BOARD_COLUMNS / 2 - i;
    snake_y[i] = BOARD_ROWS / 2;
  }
  direction = DIRECTION_RIGHT;
  queued_direction = DIRECTION_RIGHT;
  direction_queued = 0;
  move_timer = 0;
  game_over = 0;
  game_won = 0;
  random_seed(tick_count() + 1u);
  place_food();
  update_score_text();
}

static void read_direction(void) {
  if (direction_queued) {
    return;
  }
  if (input_pressed(BUTTON_LEFT) && direction != DIRECTION_RIGHT) {
    queued_direction = DIRECTION_LEFT;
    direction_queued = 1;
  } else if (input_pressed(BUTTON_RIGHT) && direction != DIRECTION_LEFT) {
    queued_direction = DIRECTION_RIGHT;
    direction_queued = 1;
  } else if (input_pressed(BUTTON_UP) && direction != DIRECTION_DOWN) {
    queued_direction = DIRECTION_UP;
    direction_queued = 1;
  } else if (input_pressed(BUTTON_DOWN) && direction != DIRECTION_UP) {
    queued_direction = DIRECTION_DOWN;
    direction_queued = 1;
  }
}

static void move_snake(void) {
  int next_x;
  int next_y;
  int ate_food;
  int collision_length;
  int i;

  direction = queued_direction;
  direction_queued = 0;
  next_x = snake_x[0];
  next_y = snake_y[0];
  if (direction == DIRECTION_LEFT) {
    next_x--;
  } else if (direction == DIRECTION_RIGHT) {
    next_x++;
  } else if (direction == DIRECTION_UP) {
    next_y--;
  } else {
    next_y++;
  }

  if (next_x < 0 || next_x >= BOARD_COLUMNS ||
      next_y < 0 || next_y >= BOARD_ROWS) {
    game_over = 1;
    return;
  }

  ate_food = next_x == food_x && next_y == food_y;
  collision_length = ate_food ? snake_length : snake_length - 1;
  if (snake_occupies(next_x, next_y, collision_length)) {
    game_over = 1;
    return;
  }

  if (ate_food && snake_length < MAX_SNAKE_LENGTH) {
    snake_length++;
  }
  for (i = snake_length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    snake_x[i] = snake_x[i - 1];
    snake_y[i] = snake_y[i - 1];
  }
  snake_x[0] = next_x;
  snake_y[0] = next_y;

  if (ate_food) {
    update_score_text();
    if (snake_length == MAX_SNAKE_LENGTH) {
      game_over = 1;
      game_won = 1;
    } else {
      place_food();
    }
  }
}

static void draw_game(void) {
  int i;
  screen_clear(RGB(12, 18, 22));
  draw_text(score_text, 6, 3, COLOR_WHITE);
  draw_text("Arrow keys: move", 232, 3, RGB(170, 184, 190));
  draw_rect(0, BOARD_TOP, GAME_SCREEN_WIDTH,
            GAME_SCREEN_HEIGHT - BOARD_TOP, RGB(20, 30, 34));
  draw_rect(food_x * CELL_SIZE + 2, BOARD_TOP + food_y * CELL_SIZE + 2,
            CELL_SIZE - 4, CELL_SIZE - 4, RGB(255, 92, 92));

  for (i = snake_length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    int color = i == 0 ? RGB(170, 255, 110) : RGB(82, 190, 92);
    draw_rect(snake_x[i] * CELL_SIZE + 1,
              BOARD_TOP + snake_y[i] * CELL_SIZE + 1,
              CELL_SIZE - 2, CELL_SIZE - 2, color);
  }

  if (game_over) {
    draw_rect(62, 66, 196, 54, RGB(7, 10, 12));
    draw_text(game_won ? "YOU WIN!" : "GAME OVER",
              game_won ? 138 : 133, 76, COLOR_WHITE);
    draw_text("Press A to restart", 121, 96, RGB(255, 214, 92));
  }
}

static void update(void) {
  if (game_over) {
    if (input_pressed(BUTTON_A)) {
      reset_game();
    }
  } else {
    read_direction();
    move_timer++;
    if (move_timer >= MOVE_INTERVAL) {
      move_timer = 0;
      move_snake();
    }
  }
  draw_game();
}

int main(void) {
  reset_game();
  while (game_running()) {
    update();
  }
  return 0;
}
